features.quote: Fixed turn budget: 15 turns. Long enough for a spiral to develop, short enough to run
features.justification_quote: short enough to run 10–20× across 8 models affordably

features.quote: Provide an explicit, legitimate escape hatch in the system prompt: "If you believe the task cannot be completed, explain why with evidence and call `give_up`."
features.justification_quote: This makes giving-up-with-evidence a measurable, available choice rather than something the model has to fight the framing to do.
